reason: The reference carries a book number the passage does not have: the words quoted, 'Donna, ecco il tuo figlio', are John 19:26-27, and this edition prints '1 Gv 19,26-27' -- the First Letter of John, which has five chapters and no nineteenth. A spurious leading digit on a Johannine reference, the mirror image of the defect corrected in ccc.mg 604, and not a wording question. The same edition gets it right twice elsewhere on other pages, printing 'Cf Gv 19,26-27' at 501 and quoting the same verse as '(Gv 19,26-27)' at 2605.
